notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Control when and what kind of notifications you receive
notifications.masterDesc: Allow PeaceFlow to send notifications to your device
notifications.morningDesc: Reminds you to check in your mood at the start of the day
notifications.eveningDesc: Reminds you to check in your mood before sleep
notifications.tasksDesc: Suggests tasks that fit your current mood
notifications.streakDesc: Notifies you when you're about to lose your activity streak
notifications.achievementsDesc: When you earn a new badge or level up
notifications.insightsDesc: Mood analysis and improvement suggestions every week
notifications.expertDesc: When an expert sends you a new task or message
notifications.communityDesc: When someone responds to your posts
notifications.note: 💡 PeaceFlow sends at most 2-3 notifications/day — never spamming or pressuring you.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Customize colors, font, and effects
appearance.themeSectionDesc: Pick the theme that matches your mood
appearance.animationsDesc: Toggle motion effects across the app
appearance.soundsDesc: Meditation music and nature sounds during exercises
appearance.hapticsDesc: Light vibration when completing tasks or earning achievements

checkin.title: Mood check-in
checkin.subtitle: Customize how you track your daily mood
checkin.defaultModeDesc: How you prefer to check in your mood
checkin.notesDesc: Show a short notes field after each check-in
checkin.tagsDesc: Show suggested tags (Work, Family, ...) after check-in
checkin.assessmentReminderDesc: Suggest taking the standardized test every 2 weeks
checkin.voiceDesc: Let AI analyze your voice to better understand your mood
checkin.selfieDesc: Analyze facial expressions to support mood assessment
checkin.note: 🔒 Voice and selfie analysis are entirely opt-in. Data is processed locally and never stored.

ai.title: PeaceCat AI
ai.subtitle: Customize how PeaceCat accompanies you
ai.taskSuggestionsDesc: PeaceCat automatically suggests tasks based on your mood and history
ai.insightsDesc: PeaceCat analyzes and comments on your journey
ai.crisisDesc: AI automatically detects danger signs and triggers emergency support
ai.journalDesc: AI reads and analyzes emotions in your journal
ai.mascotDesc: Show the origami cat mascot in the interface
ai.note: 🐱 Note: PeaceCat AI is only a companion, not a replacement for a mental health professional. The crisis detection feature cannot be turned off, to keep you safe.

devices.title: Connected devices
devices.subtitle: Current session and real device integration status
devices.wearableDesc: No real connection API in the backend yet
devices.note: PeaceFlow doesn't have a real Apple Watch/Fitbit sync backend yet. This page only shows the current session and integration status honestly.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Control how your data is used within the product
privacy.shareDataDesc: Let the system use mood, journal, and task data for better suggestions
privacy.analyticsDesc: Send anonymous statistics to improve the product, without private content
privacy.visibilityDesc: How visible your profile is on community features

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Manage the current session and authentication
security.autoRefreshDesc: The short-lived access token is refreshed automatically while the refresh token is valid

data.title: Data
data.subtitle: Export your real account data and manage local cache
data.exportNote: JSON export bundles real data from your profile, progress, badges, and detailed report. Appearance settings stay local to this browser.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.subtitle: Sensitive actions. Only run these when you really need to.
danger.note: The backend doesn't have an account-deletion endpoint yet. This page only lets you clear local settings and log out — it doesn't simulate deleting data on the server.

toast.saveFailed: Couldn't save settings to the server.
toast.wearableNotSupported: The backend doesn't have a real wearable connection yet.
toast.logoutOnly: This page can only log you out of the current session.
toast.exportJsonOnly: This page currently only supports JSON export.
toast.resetConfirm: Clear all local settings on this browser? Data on the server won't be affected.
toast.deleteAccountNotSupported: The backend doesn't have an account-deletion endpoint yet.
toast.loadFailed: Couldn't load settings from the server.
